'''Hunter''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] of an unknown [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] or [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] that was created in an [[Imperial research facility]] on a [[frozen moon]] in the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]].

==Biography==
A [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Sith/Legends|Sith]]-[[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] created and bred by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] in a [[Imperial research facility|research facility]] as part of a cloning program initiated by [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Thrawn]]. Later, their group known as the [[Community]], the clones overthrew and killed the Imperial forces that operated the research facility. For many years the clones resided in the lower levels of this facility and during this time, Hunter fell in love with [[Alpha]] and conceived with him two daughters, [[Blessing]] and [[Grace (Human)|Grace]].

In [[41 ABY|41.5 ABY]], they escaped the facility by stealing the [[Predator (Kell Douro's ship)|''Predator'']], a [[CloakShape fighter/Legends|CloakShape fighter]], that had been flown to the moon by the [[Anzat (species)|Anzat]] Sith agent, [[Kell Douro]]. Alpha was killed during their escape by [[Jaden Korr]] who had also come there to investigate a [[Force vision]].

Hunter and all of the other members of the Community, with the exception of the clone [[Soldier (clone)|Soldier]], suffered from a sickness as a result of their clone heritage. As they escaped from the research facility, they flew through the remnants of the [[Lignan]] cargo of the [[Harbinger (Sith dreadnaught)|''Harbinger'']], which had been destroyed a short time earlier. The Lignan enhanced the clones' perception of the Force but also accelerated the effects of their sickness.

At some point in the past, she and the other clones began to worship the entity known as "[[Mother (Rakatan entity)|Mother]]" under the guidance of another clone, [[Seer (clone)|Seer]]. She believed that the illness was a test that had been set for the clones by Mother and ordered Soldier to fly them to a planet called [[Fhost]] so that they could obtain medication and planned for the clones to then travel to find Mother.

On Fhost, Seer, Soldier, Hunter and the serving members of the Community that had not succumbed to the illness, deserted the [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] and stole a medical supply [[Starship/Legends|ship]] from the [[Farpoint Medical Center]]. While stealing the ship, Seer encountered the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Jaden Korr]] and the clones captured [[Khedryn Faal]], a [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] associate of Korr.

After their escape from Fhost on the medical ship, the clones headed towards Mother's location. Unfortunately, the [[Nyss Nenn]], an [[Umbaran/Legends|Umbaran]] [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] agent who had stowed away aboard the ship showed himself and killed both Hunter and [[Runner (clone)|Runner]].

==Behind the scenes==
In ''Riptide'', the template for Hunter was never explicitly stated, but the color of her hair and eyes, the name "Hunter", and the fact that on the only two other female clones, one clone was Lumiya's and the other had black hair, strongly suggested [[Mara Jade Skywalker]]. However, Khedryn Faal personally knew Mara Jade Skywalker as he was rescued by her and [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] from [[Outbound Flight]] and would have recognized her when he found her dead body.
